Kids Bible Class · September — Week 1

Daniel and the Lions

Daniel 6:1-23
Who is always with you?

“God is with you wherever you go.”

Joshua 1:9 (NLT)

God is always with me.

Image 1

Daniel loved God very much, and he worked for the king.

Daniel did such a good job that the king wanted to put him in charge of the whole kingdom!

Image 2

But some of the other leaders were jealous of Daniel.

They made a sneaky new rule: for thirty days, no one could pray to anyone except the king.

Anyone who did would be thrown to the lions!

Image 3

Daniel heard about the new rule. But he still went to his window,

got down on his knees, and prayed to God — just like he always did.

Daniel would not stop talking to God.

Image 4

So Daniel was thrown into the den of lions.

The king was very sad, but God had a plan.

God sent an angel to shut the lions' mouths, and the lions did not hurt Daniel at all!

Image 5

In the morning, the king ran to the den and called out, “Daniel! Are you okay?”

“My God sent His angel and kept me safe!” Daniel answered.

God was with Daniel the whole time. And God is always with me.

What We Learn

Daniel kept praying to God even when it was scary and even when it got him thrown into a den of lions. God did not leave Daniel alone — He sent an angel and kept him safe all night long. God was with Daniel in the very scariest place.

For you: When you feel afraid — at night, at a new school, or when something hard happens — you are never alone. God is with you, just like He was with Daniel.
